input.title: Regulated Isolated Flyback HV Charger with Capacitive Actuator Output driven by HV optocouplers in Half-bridge configuration
input.description: This architecture uses the rechargeable battery and 5 V USB charging front end to feed a protected low-voltage power rail, then drives an isolated high-frequency flyback high-voltage converter and a Diode-Capacitor-based Voltage Multiplier whose rectified secondary creates a HV bus with a fixed 14 kV output.After the HV Bus, two HV optical diode or optocoupler are implemented in a Half-bridge configuration with the channel output connected into the middle of the half-bridge,  such that it can be connected to the HV bus or shorted in the charge and discharge process respectively.Non additional high-voltage output capacitor is required and the only additional energy of the secondary HV Bus is provided by Diode-Capacitor-based Voltage Multipliers. A high-impedance sensing divider or isolated voltage feedback path is used by the controller to keep the bus stable at 14 kV. Charge rate is controlled by the PWM of the Low Voltage optocoupler inputs between 100% and 0% duty cycle. Additional voltage measurement feedback is required to monitor the charge of each output channel. Primary-side current limiting and cycle-by-cycle energy control so the 5 nF load can be charged at 2 Hz to 8 Hz while limiting current during arcing or short-circuit conditions. Discharge is handled by a normally enabled fail-safe bleed path plus the Low Side optocoupler to actively commanded high-voltage discharge path sized to reduce 14 kV on 5 nF to below 60 V within 1 s. The same PCB includes battery charge management, battery protection, thermal sensing, USB reverse-polarity and surge/ESD protection, a low-power controller, sealed user controls, and state indication. EMC is addressed with input filtering at the charging interface, shielding/guarding around the high-voltage node, spread-spectrum or fixed ultrasonic switching above audible range, and reinforced/double insulation between the case-accessible circuits and high-voltage region. This is the simplest single-channel architecture and minimizes interconnect complexity, but the flyback transformer and output rectifier stack must be designed carefully for 14 kV insulation stress.

ic_components.ic_type: USB single-cell Li-ion linear charger and power-path manager
ic_components.description: 5 V USB input single-cell Li-ion/Li-poly charger with dynamic power-path management, input over-voltage protection, thermal regulation, charge termination, status outputs, and system rail support while charging.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Approved manufacturer with highest preference. Fits 5 V USB rechargeable battery front end, provides robust production-grade charge management and power-path behavior so the system can run while charging. Input operating range and safety features align with protected low-voltage portable product architecture.

ic_components.description: Secondary lithium-ion protector for cell over-voltage, under-voltage, and over-current/short-circuit protection with low quiescent current.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Approved high-preference manufacturer. Adds dedicated pack-level protection independent of charger and MCU, improving robustness against abuse and fault conditions expected in a fielded product.

ic_components.description: High-efficiency buck-boost converter generating regulated system rail from single-cell battery across charge/discharge range with integrated switches and power-save operation.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Approved highest-preference source. A buck-boost rail is appropriate because battery voltage can be above or below the required regulated logic rail during operation. Supports professional power integrity and good efficiency versus purely linear regulation.

ic_components.description: Ultra-low quiescent current LDO used to derive a clean analog rail for sensing, references, and precision measurements from the main system supply.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Adds a dedicated clean rail for feedback and ADC reference-sensitive circuitry, improving HV voltage regulation accuracy and noise immunity in a switching, high-EMI environment.

ic_components.description: Compact boost converter to generate an auxiliary higher-than-battery rail where needed for controlled drive of discharge or protection circuitry on the low-voltage side.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Provides implementation margin for controlled active discharge interface circuitry and any low-side auxiliary biasing without burdening the main rail. Chosen from approved preferred manufacturer.

ic_components.description: Current-mode PWM controller with cycle-by-cycle current limiting, UVLO, and high-frequency operation suitable for isolated flyback energy control.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Approved highest-preference source. Current-mode control directly supports the stated need for primary-side current limiting and cycle-by-cycle energy control. Can be configured for ultrasonic switching frequency and robust fault limiting. A controller approach is more appropriate than an integrated low-voltage flyback switch because the transformer and primary power stage are specialized for HV charging.

ic_components.description: High-current low-side MOSFET gate driver for the external primary switch of the flyback stage, with fast rise/fall times and strong drive capability.
ic_components.selection_rationale: A dedicated driver improves switching control, EMI management, and efficiency for the primary HV charger stage versus driving the power switch directly from the PWM controller. Selected from highest-preference approved manufacturer.

ic_components.description: Precision reinforced isolation amplifier for transferring scaled HV output feedback across the safety barrier to the low-voltage controller domain.
ic_components.selection_rationale: The design explicitly allows an isolated voltage feedback path and requires reinforced/double insulation between user-accessible circuits and HV region. This device provides a production-grade isolated analog channel for regulation and monitoring while maintaining safety isolation. TI is highest preference and offers reinforced isolation suitable for professional implementation.

ic_components.description: Reinforced isolated amplifier for accurate measurement of shunt-based primary current or fault-related analog signals while preserving barrier integrity.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Adds independent monitored current information beyond cycle-by-cycle limiting, enabling diagnostics and more reliable arc/short-circuit response. Chosen from approved high-preference manufacturer and aligned with reinforced isolation philosophy.

ic_components.description: Dual op-amp for conditioning divider feedback, filtering, threshold generation, and analog interfacing for HV regulation and discharge confirmation.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Provides robust analog front-end capability for precision filtering and comparator threshold support around HV sensing. Selected from preferred approved source with modern low-power rail-to-rail performance.

ic_components.description: Low-power comparator for hardware threshold supervision of scaled HV output or critical rails, enabling independent fault response outside firmware.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Professional design should not rely solely on firmware for HV safety-critical thresholds. This comparator supports independent hardware interlock behavior for over-voltage or safe-to-touch confirmation logic.

ic_components.description: Low-drift precision voltage reference used for stable feedback scaling, ADC accuracy, and consistent HV setpoint control.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Improves regulation stability and absolute accuracy toward the better-than-10% HV target, especially over temperature and battery variation. Selected from approved highest-preference source.

ic_components.description: Low-power microcontroller with ADC, timers, GPIO, communication interfaces, watchdog, and sufficient processing to manage charging profiles, voltage setpoints, user controls, state indication, and fault handling.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Approved highest-preference manufacturer. A modern MCU is required for command selection, sequencing, diagnostics, event logging, and future expansion. Integrated ADC/timers simplify closed-loop supervision and 2 Hz to 8 Hz cycle management.

ic_components.description: External watchdog timer to supervise MCU operation and force recovery on firmware lockup or timing faults.
ic_components.selection_rationale: For a high-voltage portable product, independent supervision is good engineering practice and improves safety and reliability beyond the internal MCU watchdog alone.

ic_components.description: High-accuracy digital temperature sensor for battery/board thermal monitoring and charger or HV converter derating logic.
ic_components.selection_rationale: The design explicitly requires thermal sensing. A precision digital sensor simplifies calibration and supports protective derating and fault shutdown in a compact system.

ic_components.description: Low-capacitance multi-channel ESD protection array for USB power and low-speed control lines exposed at the product interface.
ic_components.selection_rationale: The design explicitly calls for USB surge/ESD protection. This is a standard production-grade interface protection IC from the highest-preference approved vendor.

ic_components.description: Integrated eFuse with over-voltage protection, current limiting, inrush control, reverse current blocking, and fault reporting for the 5 V input path.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Provides a much more robust USB/front-end protection strategy than simple passive protection alone, addressing reverse-current/inrush/fault events and improving survivability in real use.

ic_components.description: Reinforced digital isolator for transferring control/status signals across the isolation barrier where direct MCU-domain connection to HV-side sensing or control logic is undesirable.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Supports a professional partitioned architecture with reinforced digital barrier communications, aiding diagnostics and safe signal transfer between accessible circuitry and HV domain.

ic_components.description: Dual Schmitt-trigger buffer for sealed switch debounce, noisy external signal cleanup, and robust logic edge conditioning.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Improves immunity to EMI and false triggering in a high-voltage switching environment, which is important for sealed user controls and reliable field operation.

ic_components.description: Programmable LED driver for multi-state visual indication independent of MCU GPIO drive limitations.
ic_components.selection_rationale: Supports professional status indication with consistent brightness and reduced MCU loading, useful for charge/discharge/fault/status outputs in a production device.

ic_components.description: Precision ADC for high-resolution measurement of scaled HV feedback, current sense, and temperature-related analog channels where MCU ADC performance is insufficient.
ic_components.selection_rationale: A dedicated precision ADC improves closed-loop accuracy margin, production calibration capability, and diagnostics for the HV charger beyond a minimal implementation. Particularly useful when using very high-impedance dividers and filtered sensing.

global_nets.name: EFUSE_IMON
global_nets.description: Analog current-monitor output of the eFuse proportional to USB input current, read by an MCU ADC channel.

global_nets.name: VBAT

global_nets.description: Protected single-cell Li-ion positive terminal (cell + through the BQ2970/FET protection path), charger BAT pin and main converter input.

global_nets.name: BAT_CELL_POS
global_nets.source: external block: Li-ion single cell battery
global_nets.description: Raw cell positive terminal sensed by the protector before the protection FETs (protector VDD/sense node).

global_nets.name: BAT_PROT_DOUT
consumers: external block: Battery protection back-to-back FET pair
global_nets.description: Discharge-FET gate drive from the protector; active-high (high = discharge path enabled), pulled low on over-discharge/over-current fault.

global_nets.name: BAT_PROT_COUT
consumers: external block: Battery protection back-to-back FET pair
global_nets.description: Charge-FET gate drive from the protector; active-high (high = charge path enabled), pulled low on cell over-voltage fault.

global_nets.name: BAT_PROT_VM
global_nets.source: external block: Battery protection back-to-back FET pair
global_nets.description: Protector VM/current-sense node at the drain of the FET pair used for over-current and charger-detect sensing.

global_nets.name: BAT_NTC
global_nets.source: external block: Battery pack NTC thermistor
global_nets.description: Battery pack thermistor divider node feeding the charger TS input and an MCU ADC channel for redundant pack temperature monitoring.

global_nets.name: VSYS
global_nets.description: Charger power-path system output rail (USB or battery sourced) feeding the buck-boost, the auxiliary boost and the LED driver.

global_nets.name: CHG_EN1
global_nets.description: Charger input-current-limit select EN1; logic level set by MCU (EN1/EN2 code selects 100 mA / 500 mA / ILIM / standby) — driven per USB enumeration result.

global_nets.name: CHG_EN2
global_nets.description: Charger input-current-limit select EN2; companion to CHG_EN1, both low selects the default 100 mA USB limit at power-up.

global_nets.name: CHG_CE_N
global_nets.description: Active-low charge-enable (CE); driven low by MCU to allow charging, high to inhibit charging during thermal derating or fault.

global_nets.name: CHG_STAT1_N
global_nets.description: Active-low open-drain charger status 1 (charging in progress); pull-up owned by the MCU block.

global_nets.name: CHG_STAT2_N
global_nets.description: Active-low open-drain charger status 2 (charge done / fault code); pull-up owned by the MCU block.

global_nets.name: CHG_PGOOD_N
global_nets.description: Active-low open-drain power-good flag indicating valid USB input present; pull-up owned by the MCU block.

global_nets.name: VBAT_MON
global_nets.source: external block: Battery voltage divider network
global_nets.description: Scaled battery voltage from the resistive divider to an MCU ADC channel for state-of-charge and cut-off supervision.

global_nets.name: 3V3_MAIN
global_nets.description: Main regulated 3.3 V logic rail from the buck-boost, supplying all low-voltage digital, the LDO input and the low-voltage (primary/controller) side of the isolators.

global_nets.name: BUCKBOOST_EN
global_nets.source: external block: Power-on / user control button assembly
global_nets.description: Active-high enable of the buck-boost converter; held high by the power-latch circuit (button + MCU keep-alive) for normal operation, low shuts the system down.

global_nets.name: SYS_KEEP_ALIVE
global_nets.description: Active-high MCU keep-alive that latches BUCKBOOST_EN high after button release; MCU drives high during normal operation and low to perform a controlled power-off.

global_nets.name: BUCKBOOST_PG
global_nets.description: Active-high open-drain power-good of the 3V3_MAIN rail; pull-up owned by the MCU block.

global_nets.name: BUCKBOOST_PS_MODE
global_nets.description: Power-save mode select (PS/SYNC); driven low by MCU for power-save at light load, high to force PWM during HV charging bursts for low ripple.

global_nets.name: 3V3_ANA
global_nets.description: Low-noise 3.3 V analog rail from the LDO for the reference, precision ADC, op-amps, comparator and low-side bias of the isolated amplifiers.

global_nets.name: LDO_EN
global_nets.description: Active-high enable of the analog LDO; driven high by MCU for normal operation, low in deep-sleep to remove the analog rail.

global_nets.name: VAUX_12V

external block: Active bleed / discharge control interface
global_nets.description: Auxiliary boosted rail (~12 V) from the boost converter used for gate-driver bias and controlled drive of the HV half-bridge optocoupler input LEDs.

global_nets.name: BOOST_AUX_EN
global_nets.description: Active-high shutdown/enable pin of the auxiliary boost; driven high by MCU to enable VAUX_12V before HV operation, low to disable.

global_nets.name: VAUX_MON
global_nets.source: external block: Auxiliary rail divider network
global_nets.description: Scaled VAUX_12V feedback to an MCU ADC channel for auxiliary rail supervision before enabling HV charge.

global_nets.name: GND_LV
global_nets.source: external block: Li-ion single cell battery
consumers: external block: USB-C receptacle / charging connector
global_nets.description: Single main low-voltage ground of the user-accessible domain; the USB connector shell/return and the battery return both tie to it at one point, the charger power-path ground pin (star point). Galvanically separated from GND_HV by the reinforced isolation barrier.

global_nets.name: PGND_SW

global_nets.description: Primary-side switching power ground for the flyback MOSFET source/shunt return and gate-driver return; ties to GND_LV at a single point at the current-sense shunt low-side pad.

global_nets.name: PWM_HV_ENABLE

global_nets.name: PWM_GATE_CMD
global_nets.description: PWM controller OUT signal driving the gate-driver input; active-high pulse train at the ultrasonic switching frequency.

global_nets.name: FLY_GATE
consumers: external block: Flyback primary power stage (MOSFET, shunt, snubber)
global_nets.description: High-current gate drive to the flyback primary MOSFET; active-high turn-on referenced to PGND_SW.

global_nets.name: FLY_PRI_DRAIN
global_nets.source: external block: Flyback primary power stage (MOSFET, shunt, snubber)
global_nets.description: Primary switching node between the flyback MOSFET drain and the transformer primary winding, with RCD snubber; high dv/dt noisy node.

global_nets.name: FLY_PRI_VIN
global_nets.description: Primary-side bulk supply feeding the flyback transformer primary winding (taken from the main regulated rail node with local bulk capacitance).

global_nets.name: PRI_ISENSE

global_nets.name: PRI_ISENSE_MEAS

global_nets.name: COMP_FB_PRI

global_nets.name: FLY_SEC_HV_AC

global_nets.name: GND_HV

external block: Fail-safe bleed resistor chain
external block: HV output connector / 5 nF load interface

external_blocks.name: Auxiliary rail divider network
external_blocks.description: Resistive divider producing a scaled VAUX_12V voltage for the MCU ADC.

external_blocks.name: Flyback primary power stage (MOSFET, shunt, snubber)
external_blocks.description: Primary switching MOSFET, current-sense shunt and RCD snubber of the isolated flyback converter.

external_blocks.name: HV flyback transformer
external_blocks.description: Reinforced-insulation high-frequency flyback transformer with HV secondary and isolated auxiliary bias winding.

external_blocks.name: Diode-capacitor voltage multiplier stack
external_blocks.description: Cascaded diode-capacitor multiplier rectifying the HV secondary to the 14 kV bus.

external_blocks.name: HV sensing divider (high-impedance)
external_blocks.description: Guarded high-impedance resistor chain scaling the 14 kV bus for isolated feedback.

external_blocks.name: HV channel sensing divider
external_blocks.description: Guarded high-impedance divider measuring the half-bridge midpoint channel voltage on the HV side.

external_blocks.name: HV-side channel monitor conditioning
external_blocks.description: HV-domain conditioning/encoder circuitry converting channel divider voltage into a duty-encoded digital signal for the isolator.

external_blocks.name: HV half-bridge optocoupler high side
external_blocks.description: High-voltage optically-coupled switch connecting HV_BUS_14KV to the channel output during charging.

external_blocks.name: HV half-bridge optocoupler low side
external_blocks.description: High-voltage optically-coupled switch shorting the channel output to GND_HV during commanded discharge.

external_blocks.name: LV optocoupler LED drive stage
external_blocks.description: Low-voltage current-limited LED drive circuit for the high-side HV optocoupler input, PWM controlled.

external_blocks.name: Active bleed / discharge control interface
external_blocks.description: Low-voltage drive circuit for the low-side HV optocoupler input implementing commanded active discharge.

external_blocks.name: Fail-safe bleed resistor chain
external_blocks.description: Normally-enabled high-voltage bleed resistor string permanently discharging the HV bus/channel for fail-safe operation.

external_blocks.name: HV output connector / 5 nF load interface
external_blocks.description: Insulated high-voltage output terminal driving the 5 nF capacitive load.

external_blocks.name: HV enable interlock logic
external_blocks.description: Discrete hardware AND/latch network combining reset and over-voltage interlock to inhibit HV generation.

external_blocks.name: Status indicator LEDs
external_blocks.description: Multi-color status LEDs for charge, discharge, fault and ready indication.

external_blocks.name: Power-on / user control button assembly
external_blocks.description: Sealed membrane/tactile user switches including the power-latch button.

external_blocks.name: SWD programming/debug header
external_blocks.description: Service header providing SWD debug, reset and UART diagnostics access.
